Guides / Hunting / Weather & time of day

Weather & time of day

How each island's weather and the clock change what you meet.

Each island rolls its weather once an hour (the same everywhere for that hour). Weather changes both who turns up and how battles play out.

IslandClearRainHarsh sunAsh stormSnowFog
Dewleaf Town85%15%––––
Sunny Shore70%30%––––
Ashen Peak55%–30%15%––
Misty Pyre60%––––40%
Frostveil Peak25%–––60%15%
Skyhigh Cliffs64%15%–––21%
Voltage Works40%45%–14%––
Dragonspire40%–34%25%––

Who turns up

  • In weather, Pokémon of its types are ×4 as likely to be picked (Rain: Water Electric; Harsh sun: Fire Grass; Ash storm: Rock Ground Steel; Snow: Ice; Fog: Ghost Psychic Fairy).
  • At night (7pm to 6am on your clock) Ghost Dark Poison are ×3 as likely and Grass Bug Normal Fairy ×0.5; in the day those day types are ×1.4.
  • Visitors: in weather 20% of encounters (10% at night) can be a visitor of a boosted type from this island or an earlier one, so weather never brings late Pokémon in early.

Battle effects of each weather are on Types & type chart. Gym Leaders keep their own weather.
